name: cowsay-lite
description: A tiny ASCII cow that repeats what you say.

name: figlet-mini
description: Generates small ASCII-art banners from text.
installation_command:
mkdir -p ~/.ark/packages/figlet-mini && printf '#!/bin/sh
for word in "$@"; do printf "== %s ==
" "$word" | tr a-z A-Z; done
' > ~/.ark/packages/figlet-mini/figlet && chmod +x ~/.ark/packages/figlet-mini/figlet

name: fortune-ark
installation_command:
mkdir -p ~/.ark/packages/fortune-ark && printf '#!/bin/sh
quotes=("Talk is cheap. Show me the code." "Programs must be written for people to read." "Simplicity is prerequisite for reliability." "Make it work, make it right, make it fast.")
echo "${quotes[$((RANDOM %% ${#quotes[@]}))]}"
' > ~/.ark/packages/fortune-ark/fortune && chmod +x ~/.ark/packages/fortune-ark/fortune

name: weather-cli
description: One-line weather lookup powered by wttr.in.

name: sysinfo-ark
description: Quick system summary: kernel, uptime and memory.

name: emerge
description: Gentoo-style USE flags with Debian-grade safety: an ark extension.

name: hello-gentoo
installation_command:
mkdir -p ~/.ark/packages/hello-gentoo && cat > ~/.ark/packages/hello-gentoo/hello-gentoo <<'EOF'
#!/bin/sh
U=$(cat "$HOME/.ark/emerge/package.use/hello-gentoo" 2>/dev/null || true)
echo -n "hello-gentoo"
echo "$U" | grep -q "+fancy" && echo -n " (fancy!)"
echo "$U" | grep -q "+color" && printf '\033[32m in COLOR\033[0m'
echo
echo "$U" | grep -q "+quotes" && echo '"Talk is cheap. Show me the code."'
EOF
chmod +x ~/.ark/packages/hello-gentoo/hello-gentoo

name: super-cow
description: Super cow powers. Depends on hello (dependency safety demo).
installation_command:
mkdir -p ~/.ark/packages/super-cow && cat > ~/.ark/packages/super-cow/super-cow <<'EOF'
#!/bin/sh
echo "super cow engaged"
echo '   (__)'
echo '   (oo)\_______'
echo '   (__)\       )\/\'
echo '       ||----w |'
echo '       ||     ||'
echo "dependency check: $(~/.ark/packages/hello/hello 2>/dev/null || echo MISSING)"
EOF
chmod +x ~/.ark/packages/super-cow/super-cow
